claim: Patchline ships analytics-free documentation feedback forms that turn reader input into structured local issue templates without any tracking, network calls, or third-party scripts. Each form is defined by a name, a set of labelled fields with required flags, and the issue label it produces; the worker renders a plain-Markdown form plus a structured local issue template that a reader can fill in and paste, with no external assets whatsoever. The gate proves every form renders all its fields, marks required fields, emits a structured template, and contains zero external URLs or analytics references.
real_repo: patchline (self): feedback forms rendered as local-only templates
